title: Intrinsic Guardrails: How Semantic Geometry of Personality Interacts with Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
reasoning: The paper explores the 'moral coordinate system' of LLMs and how 'ethical valence' is represented within the model's personality space. It specifically benchmarks the model's alignment with safety and human values using interventions on these internal ethical axes, discussing concepts like 'moral blindness' and 'prosocial' behavior.
